notes.title: The Multilingual International Version is Officially Released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632623/fe5e1629b1fe094571ef87faa8933e2ea6356da2.png

After nearly a year of preparation, we finally bring you the multilingual international version!

This international version supports Chinese, English, and Korean, and has enhanced the original storyline to a certain extent.

We encountered numerous difficulties in translating and software for this multilingual version, but thankfully, we pulled through with the help of my friends. I'm immensely grateful for their support.

I set the release promotion day on my birthday, wishing to leave a memorable mark for myself!

BlueBirdStory's new project is already in the planning stages. We are currently developing the Unity test demo for our new work, and hope to bring you our new creation soon! 

(This game also has iOS/Android versions. We've put a lot of effort into developing both versions, so feel free to try it on your mobile devices! It's available on App Store and Google Play!)

notes.title: Two weeks after its release, English version is on the way！
notes.notes:
I'm sorry that it's not available in English. I'm the only one in the BlueBIrdStory studio. I am a Chinese writer and programmer, and the core gameplay of this game is story, so the English translation will take time.

Thank you for paying attention to my game.
